item.description: DATE/FORMAT PARTICIPANTS / INFO [27.04.2025] RADIO ARCTIC PRE-RECORDED INTERVIEW The fourth and final episode of the Radio Arctic x Polar Journal podcast series explores the dynamic and evolving role of ‘female leadership and entrepreneurship across the Arctic’. In conversation with prominent Arctic figures, Sara Olsvig, Tahnee Prior, Sarah Cox, and Lydie Lescarmontier — this episode uncovers the critical intersections of gender, governance, and sustainability in the Polar regions.
